text_block_list.text:
Following her victory at Hanshin Racecourse,
I accompanied Biwa Hayahide to a salon rumored to have elite stylists.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the hair salon City-kun was talking about...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And over here is a popular head spa.
Their slogan is "Dramatic evolution, starting from the scalp"—
and apparently it's seriously effective.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They say cleaning your scalp changes your hair quality, too.
—Ah... Oh no.
Looks like they relocated. To Kansai.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised when I heard it had moved to Kansai.
Yet, with these legs that brought me victory in races,
I have finally arrived...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am going to part ways with this rampaging hair now.
...Please wait here for me.

Just how would it be reborn?
My heart pounded with anticipation as I waited—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting... Trainer.

When I turned around, a fantastical world spread out before me.
Biwa Hayahide, standing right in its center, almost looked as if she were bathed in a holy halo...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how about it, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see you noticed after all.
My hair quality has improved even more than it appears!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...That was an exquisite head spa.
My hair rejoiced with every pressure point pressed...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And with a custom treatment formulated
by the latest AI based on our database,
my hair will be as soft as a celestial maiden's robe...!!
choice_data_list: Man, it was just incredible, huh!
It was just so amazing, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the excitement just won't die down...!
It's just like when I win a race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna go get some fresh air!

Biwa Hayahide dashed off like a child
bursting with joy, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What is the meaning of this...?!
Trainer, my body's movements are somehow completely different from usual...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even a light jog makes my movements stiff, like a tin doll...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... It's the hair!
The drastic change in hair texture altered the aerodynamic drag, and my theoretical calculations and physical body haven't adapted yet!"
choice_data_list: Guess I'll just have to fix my hair...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-What did you say...!? You're telling me...
it'll go back to the hair texture that's plagued me for years...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, I need to reconstruct the theory.
If I pull an all-nighter starting today, I can make it for the next race—"
Waaaahhh~~!!

A short distance away, someone was crying.
...It was the Umamusume who had raced against Biwa Hayahide today.
She was stuffing takoyaki into her mouth through her tears.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... Next time I w-won't lose...!
Just you wait, Biwa Hayahide~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“......Apparently, if I skip the special hair treatment for even a single day,
my hair goes right back to how it was.
Naturally, I bought it by the crate.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Could you hold onto this for me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I have so many rivals, you see.
I don't think I can afford to fuss over my hair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's save that...
until the moment we feel we've truly given it our all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you until then... Trainer.

Biwa Hayahide's radiant expression
shone just as brightly as the setting sun!
